stages.claim: Once an appropriate shell exists, its 2 base-time mining may yield zero or one egg at 50 percent spoilage. Plant prerequisites/nutrient craft trigger open egg work; science needs its own prior research and 100 bioflux trigger. Wrong pressure 2000 blocks biological recipes. Initial fight/shell generation not traced.

Spend the actual egg on reproduction or consume it with bioflux for science; holding risks expiry. Reproduction defines 1 egg+30 nutrients+60 water/15 base seconds; science 1 egg+1 bioflux/4 base seconds. Chamber separately needs nutrient fuel 500 kW at speed 2. Recipe ingredient nutrients are not all fuel costs.

Non-spoiled completed reproduction defines 2 fresh eggs; one returned seed is ignored by productivity. Freshness reset is conditional. Actual sampling, fuel and crafting execution is closed C++ specified by API, not demonstrated by running Lua.

Agricultural science enters actual base lab inputs, funds tree-seeding alongside four other science categories for 50 units and unlocks wood-processing. The pack itself expires after 1 hour into spoilage. Engine research/freshness use not source-inspected.

Egg base expiry 15 minutes; a half-spoiled normal egg has only 7.5 base minutes remaining. Each expired egg defines a hostile premature big-wriggler trigger with collision fallback and abort-over-space exceptions. Wrong surface, missing seed/fuel or late input prevent usable supply. Exact mid-craft loss/refund/tick and stack merging stay unknown.

Reverse generator consumes 1 armor and constructs quarter solid ingredient quantities with fractional extra product; fluids are not returned. Recycler adds 180 kW electricity/speed 0.5, permits quality but not productivity.

Actual data-updates invokes the generator and supplies hidden reverse recipes. Quarter-return arithmetic is source-visible; runtime item consumption, integer parsing and probabilistic output/quality preservation are C++/documented. A single sacrifice is not a guaranteed 25 percent refund.

MK 2 armor binds 10 x 10 base grid. Rare level 2 plus documented width/height bonuses yields 12 x 12 capacity target, enabling different simultaneous owned equipment means. Engine grid insertion returns equipment or nil if it cannot be added; actual layout/power/body execution was not inspected. This differs from native YAIRPG attack/defense quality multiplier.

No universal dismantle refund: fluid loss, multi-output/category/auto_recycle exclusions, self-return fallback 25 percent chance and missing productivity are separate. Engine fit can fail; unlimited profitable or guaranteed Legendary rerolls are not inferred. Equipped-armor recycling protection/inventory shrink behavior unreviewed.

original_packet.title: Two independently aging assay cultures with useful terminal use
original_packet.source_readiness: conditional: explicit lot identity, native adapters and compatibility policy required before implementation
original_packet.scope: Same living player/Eda and existing permitted Village bench; first one-realm/one-prestige milestone. Original names/numbers remain proposals. Quality housing stays a broader unselected design.
original_packet.prepare: After actual existing home terms/research, a 2 minute job spends one owned Tree sap, one newly authored Empty assay vial and 1 stamina to produce one Live staining vial lot at completion. At most two active lots, made at different played-clock times. New vial item definitions/bindings are required future content, not assumed existing items. Old Tree sap remains stable.
original_packet.property: Each physical lot has distinct ID, actual owner/holder, bornAt and a 6 played-minute live deadline from actual completion. Knowledge/transfer/job pause cannot refresh it.
original_packet.choice_and_consumer: Spend one live lot on a three-minute bench assay with Eda's actual present consent, usable body and existing supported Grain matching method. Pay her one native coin and spend one stamina from each participant. The assay reveals a current defect on one held repair piece and records firsthand understanding that qualifies one corrective fitting action. The assay changes the used live vial to one spent vial for later cleaning, conserving its glass. No tool, repair stock or numeric quality is granted. The corrective fitting target needs one explicitly bound repair-object identity; a shared fact on two fungible same-key pieces is insufficient. A separate two-minute stabilization spends one sap and one player stamina, irrevocably changing the live vial into an inert calibration film plus the returned empty glass vial. The film supplies one ordinary jig-calibration use on a known repair layout, but can no longer perform the living assay. Or retain the live sample for another piece and accept its own deadline.
original_packet.expiry_aftermath: At its own deadline, live lot becomes one Spent staining vial at actual holder/site, once only. Glass remains; observed failed-sample/spill record, no forced NPC damage/combat. A 1 minute/1 stamina cleanup returns one Empty assay vial without knowledge/material reward.

missing_consumers.gap: Lot identity/deadline absent from current key/reconstruction; arbitrary extra JSON fields can be ignored. Select validated binding/migration, not second inventory. The original assay also needs one supported repair-object identity for its result; select an existing persistent local object or explicitly bind it before content authoring.
Frozen costs/effects and boundaries lack material-lot expiry/reservations; retain original deadline and qualify terminal result at common-clock boundary.
Full-key/count spends/returns and numeric quality checks need explicit conserved lot binding through custody/transfer/refund.
Validators and native reconstruction must roundtrip lot/reservation/age in existing envelope; failure cannot publish partial or refreshed goods.

original_packet.compatibility: Integrator must select optional additive lot schema/default absence and exact native binding before code work. No legacy aging/enrollment/reward, no copied timers/offline policy, no global gear-quality rewrite. Reservation/cancellation/refund retains original lot age rather than recreating fresh input.
original_packet.boundary_rule_proposal: At clock==expiry the live assay is invalid even if job due also equals expiry. Check expiry before result or require expiresAt>clock at completion. Current jobs settle before actor conditions, so a generic expiring actor condition is insufficient. Once-per-lot causes prevent duplicate conversion; proof stays local until absent-world policy is chosen.

acceptance_later.pass: Prepare two actual lots at different clock instants in generated state; verify physical vial/sap/stamina costs, distinct ID/deadline and no unknown/legacy/knowledge-only grant. Existing sap/gear quality unchanged.

Use the older live lot in the paid assay while the younger remains owned. Observe one coin entering Eda's purse, each participant's one stamina payment and piece-bound defect knowledge, with no free stock/gear. A used live lot cannot be reused.

Reach exact expiry while owned/transferred/reserved, including completion tie; once-only spent-vial conversion and failed assay at true holder/site, no refreshed refund or actor-global aging. Younger lot remains valid.

Compare live assay, stabilized calibration and expired cleanup consumers. Stabilization forfeits live assay; cleanup returns one glass vial only. Contact/body/site failure respects disclosed job policy while original age persists.

After selected implementation/rebuild, generated reload/export/import preserve lot ID/deadline/custody/reservation; failed save publishes no partial inventory/age/clock mutation. All these checks currently not run.

original_packet.gate_status: Source research only. Implementation/build/browser/unit/gameplay/save/failure/director gates deferred and unrun.

comparative_cost: Trial a bounded material-lot contract in the incumbent, then selected original content. Native/save/job adapters are moderate shared-contract work, greater than an extra recipe. No engine/library switch has demonstrated whole-task benefit. Full spatial grids/upcycling/logistical simulation remain larger unselected designs.
